threats.threat_description: An attacker captures and replays the RF challenge-response messages to impersonate the legitimate key fob, potentially unlocking the doors or starting the engine without possession of the actual key fob.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of Cryptographic Key Material and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and engine starting.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering or modification of the key fob firmware to extract cryptographic keys or alter authentication behavior, enabling unauthorized access or denial of service.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, Authenticity, and Availability of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized vehicle access, theft, or user lockout.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Hardware Analysis / Firmware Integrity Verification

threats.threat_description: Leakage of cryptographic key material or authentication protocol details from the key fob through side channels or wireless eavesdropping.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams or otherwise disrupts the RF communication channel between the key fob and vehicle RF transceiver, preventing successful authentication or entry.
An attacker generates false LF proximity signals to deceive the LF antenna into triggering a wake event, causing the vehicle to initiate RF challenges unnecessarily.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall enforce the Authenticity and Availability of LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent unnecessary vehicle wake events and RF activity leading to battery drain.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or attenuates LF signals at the door handle antenna, preventing detection of the key fob's proximity and denying entry.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall ensure the Availability of the LF Proximity Signal against Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized denial of vehicle entry for legitimate users.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering with the vehicle RF antenna or analog RF feed to modify or relay signals, enabling relay attacks or signal amplification to extend the effective range of the key fob.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of RF Challenge-Response Messages and the Vehicle Antenna RF Link against Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.

threats.threat_description: Eavesdropping on the vehicle RF antenna to capture challenge-response messages and other RF communication, potentially aiding replay or cryptanalysis attacks.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized access or replay of authentication data.

threats.threat_description: An attacker impersonates the RF transceiver by injecting forged or replayed Auth Data messages to the BCM, tricking it into accepting unauthorized responses.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of Auth Data on the BCM -> RF Transceiver Control Interface against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry or start.

threats.threat_description: Compromise or firmware modification of the RF transceiver to alter, delay, or drop RF messages, or to leak sensitive authentication data to external attackers.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability, and Authenticity of RF Transceiver Firmware and Authentication Data against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized vehicle access, starting, and leakage of sensitive cryptographic material.

threats.threat_description: Extraction of cryptographic material or sensitive authentication data from the RF transceiver firmware or memory, enabling offline cryptanalysis or impersonation.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of RF Transceiver Firmware and Authentication Data against ATM-T0039: ECU Credential Dumping to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry or start.

threats.threat_description: Disruption of RF transceiver operation, such as jamming or firmware malfunction, preventing reception or transmission of authentication messages.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of service that blocks legitimate keyless entry and start operations.

threats.threat_description: An attacker injects forged CAN bus messages impersonating the BCM to command door unlock or engine start without proper authentication tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Door Lock/Unlock and Engine Start Commands on the In-Vehicle CAN bus against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.

threats.threat_description: Modification or corruption of BCM firmware or configuration data to bypass authentication logic, disable security checks, or issue unauthorized commands.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of Firmware and Configuration Data against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized control of vehicle body functions and disabling of security features.

threats.threat_description: Lack of secure logging or audit trails in BCM allowing attackers or insiders to deny having issued unlock or start commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Accountability, Authenticity, and Integrity of Door Lock/Unlock Command and Engine Start Command audit logs against ATM-T0031: Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent denial of unauthorized command issuance and loss of forensic evidence.

threats.threat_description: Exposure of BCM configuration, authentication tokens, or internal state via debug interfaces or memory leakage, enabling attackers to analyze or bypass security.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of BCM Configuration and Access Policies and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0039: ECU Credential Dumping to prevent unauthorized vehicle start and manipulation of BCM-controlled functions.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Memory and Interface Analysis

threats.threat_description: Injection of spurious LF wake signals or flooding the BCM with bogus challenge requests, causing denial of service or battery drain.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Availability, Integrity, and Authenticity of the LF Proximity Signal and BCM -> RF Transceiver Control Interface against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent denial of service and battery drain resulting in vehicle inoperability.

threats.threat_description: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in the BCM software or cryptographic API to gain unauthorized access to cryptographic keys or issue privileged commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of the Start Authorization Token and Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0027: Exploit Isolated Execution Environment Vulnerability to prevent unauthorized vehicle start and execution of privileged BCM functions.

threats.threat_description: An attacker forges CAN messages to the Door ECU to trigger door actuation without valid authorization tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Door Lock/Unlock Command and CAN Lock/Unlock Message against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized unlocking of vehicle doors.

threats.threat_description: Modification of Door ECU firmware or CAN message handlers to bypass token verification or issue unauthorized actuator commands.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Door Lock/Unlock Command against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized door locking or unlocking and potential vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: Blocking or jamming CAN messages to the Door ECU, preventing door lock or unlock commands from being executed.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall ensure the Availability of CAN Lock/Unlock Message against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent loss of electronic door locking and unlocking functionality.

threats.threat_description: Injection of forged start authorization tokens or messages on the CAN bus to enable engine start without proper authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Engine Start Command and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: Manipulation of the Start Authorization ECU firmware or token verification logic to accept unauthorized tokens or disable checks.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized vehicle start and disabling of anti-theft mechanisms.

threats.threat_description: Interference with CAN messages or powertrain interface commands preventing authorized engine start requests from reaching the Engine ECU.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of the Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent authorized users from being unable to start the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: Eavesdropping on the CAN bus to capture lock/unlock commands and start authorization tokens, potentially enabling replay or cryptanalysis attacks if message-level protections are weak.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The CAN Bus shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of In-Vehicle CAN messages against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry or start.

threats.threat_description: Flooding the CAN bus with high-priority frames to prevent legitimate lock/unlock or start authorization messages from being delivered timely.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The CAN Bus shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of In-Vehicle CAN (broadcast medium) against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent immobilization or lockout of the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: Physical or logical compromise of the HSM hardware or firmware to extract cryptographic keys or bypass the restricted API controls.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of HSM Firmware, Secure Boot Measurements, and Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0027: Exploit Isolated Execution Environment Vulnerability to prevent compromise of cryptographic keys and unauthorized access to cryptographically protected vehicle functions.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Hardware Security Evaluation / Firmware Analysis

threats.threat_description: Leakage of cryptographic keys or sensitive verification data from the HSM secure enclave, due to side-channel attacks or firmware vulnerabilities.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0039: ECU Credential Dumping to prevent unauthorized access, impersonation, or compromise of vehicle security functions.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Side-Channel Analysis / Firmware Review

threats.threat_description: Inadequate logging or attestation in the HSM enabling denial of performed cryptographic operations or authorization token generation.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Non-repudiation of HSM Attestation / Measurement Data against ATM-T0031: Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent denial of performed cryptographic operations or authorization token generation.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Test / Audit Log Review / Attestation Protocol Validation

threats.threat_description: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in the HSM's restricted API or firmware allowing unauthorized commands or key usage beyond allowed policies.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of the Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0024: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized cryptographic operations and compromise of critical vehicle security functions.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / API Fuzzing / Firmware Review

threats.threat_description: Manipulation of the crypto engine logic inside the HSM to produce forged authorization tokens or skip verification steps.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, Confidentiality, and Availability of Cryptographic Key Material and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0075: Compromise Cryptographic Security to prevent unauthorized vehicle start and persistent compromise of the vehicle's cryptographic trust anchor.

threats.threat_description: Extraction or leakage of cryptographic keys stored persistently in the key store, allowing attackers to impersonate the vehicle or key fob.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Cryptographic Key Store shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Integrity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0039: ECU Credential Dumping to prevent unauthorized impersonation of the vehicle or key fob and subsequent vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering or manipulation of the door lock actuator to bypass electronic control and force door unlocking without proper authorization.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Door Lock/Unlock Command and Door ECU -> Actuator Signal against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized vehicle door unlocking and entry.

threats.threat_description: Mechanical failure or electronic jamming of the door lock actuator preventing lock or unlock operations, denying legitimate user access.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Availability of Door Lock/Unlock Command against ATM-T0072: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent legitimate user access denial.

threats.threat_description: Modification or compromise of the engine ECU or inverter firmware allowing unauthorized engine start or disabling engine start even with valid authorization.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Engine Start Command against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized engine start, denial of service, and unexpected engine operation.
cybersecurity_goal.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle / OBD / ECU Firmware Update Interface
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Firmware Integrity Verification / Interface Analysis

threats.threat_description: Blocking or manipulation of the powertrain start interface messages to prevent engine start despite valid authorization tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Availability, Integrity, and Authenticity of the Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized immobilization of the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: Injection of false LF wake/proximity events into the LF receiver causing the BCM to initiate unnecessary authentication flows.
linked_assets: LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall enforce the Authenticity and Availability of the BCM Event / Control Link against Manipulate Communications to prevent unnecessary authentication flows that may drain battery or degrade system performance.

threats.threat_description: Blocking or jamming of LF signals preventing legitimate detection of key fob proximity and thus denying access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of the LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of access and use for legitimate users.

threats.threat_description: Relay attacks where an adversary relays LF or RF signals over extended distances, enabling unauthorized entry or engine start by extending the range of the legitimate key fob signals. This affects the vehicle RF antenna (ANT_RF_1), RF transceiver (RF_1), BCM_1, and key fob (EXT_1) components and the communication assets C1, C2, C10.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver and Key Fob shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of LF Proximity Signal and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry and engine start.

threats.threat_description: Replay attacks where previously captured authentication messages (e.g., RF responses) are resent to the vehicle to gain unauthorized access or engine start. This impacts the RF transceiver (RF_1), BCM (BCM_1), and key fob (EXT_1) and involves communication assets C2 and I5.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF transceiver, Body Control Module, and Key Fob shall enforce the Authenticity and Confidentiality of RF Challenge-Response Messages and Auth Data against Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and engine start.

threats.threat_description: Unauthorized firmware updates or modifications to the RF transceiver or BCM firmware enabling attackers to bypass authentication, forge tokens, or control the RF interface improperly. This affects RF_1, BCM_1, and the firmware assets I7 and I3.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver and Body Control Module shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of their Firmware against Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent persistent unauthorized control over vehicle functions and loss of authentication trust.

threats.threat_description: Unauthorized access to cryptographic keys or tokens via compromised internal APIs or debug interfaces, particularly the restricted HSM API and internal communication between BCM and HSM. This involves components BCM_1, HSM_1, and assets I1, C4.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module and Hardware Security Module shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Integrity of Cryptographic Key Material and Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized disclosure or manipulation of cryptographic keys leading to ECU impersonation or unauthorized vehicle access.

threats.threat_description: False wake or trigger signals injected at the LF antenna or LF receiver causing repeated unnecessary challenge initiations and draining vehicle battery or causing denial of service. This affects ANT_1, LF_RX_1, BCM_1, and communication assets C1 and C12.
linked_assets: LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver and Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Availability, Integrity, and Authenticity of the LF Proximity Signal and BCM Event/Control Link against ATM-T0044: Network Service Scanning to prevent vehicle battery drain and denial of service.

threats.threat_description: Compromise of HSM attestation or measurement data to hide unauthorized changes or bypass security checks, affecting trust in the HSM firmware and integrity reporting. This involves HSM_1 and assets I8, I10.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, and Confidentiality of HSM Firmware / Secure Boot Measurements and HSM Attestation / Measurement Data against ATM-T0031: Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent undetected execution of unauthorized firmware and loss of trust in system integrity reporting.
